name: simple-language
description: Keeps technical explanations readable for whoever they are actually for. Skill plus auto-firing hook, so you do not have to ask for plain English every time.

plugins.name: simple-language
plugins.description: Explains technical work, findings, and decisions to non-technical readers in plain language. Installs the skill, plus a one-time /simple-language-setup command that writes the always-on rules file.
